summary: PM-002 Community Maintenance Engine (Buildings + Group Campaigns) validated end-to-end. Backend: 23/23 pytest scenarios PASS (buildings CRUD, duplicate 409, search, join 404, mine w/ opportunities, campaign create 409/403, join dedup, specialist sees campaign, offer replace not duplicate, accept-offer creates assigned direct requests with lead_fee_waived=true, no lead-fee txns, auto-detection tick idempotent). Frontend: F1 (empty state → create bloc via bh-create-*), F2 (opportunity bh-opp-hvac → bh-start-campaign-hvac → bh-campaign card 'Deschisă'), F3 (specialist spec-campaigns-section + camp-offer-price + camp-offer-submit → 'Oferta ta 320 RON/apartament'), F4 (bh-offer + bh-accept-offer → campaign 'Programată' + Asignat job in Lucrări) all PASS. One backend bug found: unescaped regex in create_building.

critical.issue: Unescaped regex injection in duplicate check — building names containing regex metacharacters ([, ], -, *, ., +, ?, (, ), etc.) cause pymongo OperationFailure (500 Internal Server Error) instead of graceful 400/409. Example: name '[TEST] Bloc' → 500 'Regular expression is invalid: range out of order in character class'. Fix: use re.escape(data.name) and re.escape(data.address) before wrapping in ^...$ regex, or better use case-insensitive collation / $eq with normalized string.

action_items: Escape regex metacharacters in POST /api/buildings duplicate-check (community_buildings.py:116-117). This is a P1 security/robustness bug — any Romanian address containing '.' or '-' could 500 in production.
critical_code_review_comments: community_buildings.py:116-117: raw f-string in $regex is a regex-injection bug (see backend_issues.critical above).

community_buildings.py:243-245: fallback query when specialist has no specialty is very broad (`status: open`) — could leak all campaigns to unspecialized specialists. Consider excluding or requiring specialty.

community_buildings.py:187-204: _notify_campaign_audience iterates all owners and specialists inside a request handler — for large buildings/many trusted specialists this could slow down create_campaign response. Consider background task.
community_buildings.py: no rate limit / cap on number of buildings a single client can create — allows abuse.

community_buildings.py:334-343: request docs written directly to db.requests without going through the standard request-creation service — risks missing fields (e.g., created_at parseable, twin sync, analytics events). Verified fields are present but keeping in a single service would be safer.

rca of the issue: POST /api/buildings 500 on names with regex metachars: create_building builds a MongoDB $regex from user input without escaping. The `[` in `[TEST]` opens a character class; the parser then interprets the trailing `-` (`-ITER146]`) as a range operator and MongoDB throws code 51091 'range out of order'. Reproduction: `curl -X POST /api/buildings -d '{"name":"[TEST] Bloc","address":"x"}' -H 'Cookie: sid=...'` → 500. Mitigation: `import re; regex_name = f'^{re.escape(data.name)}$'; regex_addr = f'^{re.escape(data.address)}$'`.
